name: werkcv
description: Check a CV for jobs in the Netherlands, compare it with a job posting, and open it in the WerkCV editor.

interface.longDescription:
WerkCV reviews your CV (résumé) for jobs in the Netherlands. Share your CV in Dutch or English and ask ChatGPT to check it, or add a job posting to compare the two.

Check a CV: get a score out of 100 with feedback on content, contact details, layout for applicant tracking systems (ATS) and Dutch CV conventions, plus the three changes to make first.

Compare with a job posting: see which requirements your CV meets, partly meets or misses, and which keywords from the posting are missing from your CV.

Open in the editor: get a link that opens your CV in the WerkCV editor on werkcv.nl so you can make the changes.

Checks and comparisons are not stored. The job posting comparison is processed by OpenAI. For the editor link, WerkCV keeps the CV text until the link is opened, for at most 60 minutes.
defaultPrompt: Check my CV for jobs in the Netherlands
Does my CV fit this vacancy?
Which keywords from this job ad are missing from my CV?

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell anything or process payments in ChatGPT, and it does not show prices or link to a checkout. open_in_editor links to the WerkCV editor on werkcv.nl, where editing is free.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_cv once. Answers in Dutch with the score (around 69 of 100, grade about 6.9), notes that no bullet has a number, and gives the three fixes to make first, each quoting the exact line from the CV (for example 'Verantwoordelijk voor social media kanalen'). May offer to open the CV in the editor.

Vacature:
Performance Marketeer – Fietsenplein
Fietsenplein is een snelgroeiende webshop in fietsen en accessoires uit Utrecht. Voor ons marketingteam zoeken we een Performance Marketeer.

Wat ga je doen
- Je beheert onze campagnes in Google Ads en Meta Ads met een maandbudget van €40.000.
- Je voert A/B-tests uit op landingspagina's en advertenties.
- Je werkt samen met het contentteam aan SEO.
- Je zet e-mailflows op in Klaviyo.

Wat vragen wij
- Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in performance marketing, bij voorkeur e-commerce.
- Aantoonbare resultaten met Google Ads en Meta Ads.
- Ervaring met GA4 en Looker Studio.
- Analytisch sterk; je werkt datagedreven.
- HBO werk- en denkniveau.
- Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal; goed Engels is een pré.

Wat bieden wij
Een fulltime baan van 36 tot 40 uur, een goed salaris en een eigen fiets van de zaak.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls match_vacancy. Lists the requirements as must or nice and match, partial or missing, with quotes from the CV and the vacancy, names missing keywords such as Meta Ads, GA4 and Looker Studio, and gives the fixes to make first. Does not advise claiming experience the CV does not show.
